name: Language change

Grammar changes are the highest-stakes contributions here, because the whole
language has to stay learnable from a single page. Please cover all four.

### What it lets someone express

Something they cannot express today. A concrete `.ux` snippet helps.

### What it costs

The grammar section of `SKILL.md` is capped at 800 tokens and currently sits at
422. Roughly what does this add — and if it pushed past the cap, what would you
remove to pay for it?

### Benchmark impact

Parse rate and fidelity, before and after, from `bench/`. If you have not run
it, say so — it is not a blocker for opening the issue, but the change cannot
land without it.

### Alternatives you considered

Particularly anything expressible with the existing grammar.
